rv.q: Quinn's timing is impeccable, and his gift for mimicry allows him to slip in and out of character with the fluidity of a natural-born storyteller.

Colin Quinn is not trying to bring back the ethnic joke, is he? Please, he's much too deep and smart for that, right? And yet, there is a nostalgia -- better, an exasperated, irritated wistfulness -- in his shaggy, fast-moving new 65-minute solo show "Colin Quinn: The New York Story," which contends that false civility has led to "eggshell walki...
Quinn's rapid-fire delivery and keen observations about human nature keep the audience engaged, even when his historical timeline gets a bit wobbly.
